sources.entry: MeetingBar - Menu bar app for your calendar meetings

summary.one_liner: MeetingBar is a lightweight macOS menu-bar app that shows your current or next calendar meeting and lets you join it with one click.
summary.what_it_does: Shows the current or next meeting in the macOS status bar, with title, time, countdown, icon, or meeting service as display options. It detects meeting links in calendar events and supports macOS Calendar (any account synced with Calendar.app) and Google Calendar connected directly. The menu lists today's and tomorrow's events, with filters for all-day, declined, tentative, pending, or linkless events. It can join the nearest meeting via a global keyboard shortcut, create ad-hoc meetings, and open links in a chosen browser or native app per service. It also sends macOS notifications and full-screen reminders before meetings, and offers bookmarks, launch at login, Shortcuts and AppleScript integration.
use_cases: join meetings from the menu bar
see next calendar event on mac
join Zoom or Google Meet with one click
show Google Calendar in the macOS menu bar
how_to_run: Download MeetingBar from the Mac App Store
Download the latest DMG from the releases page
Open MeetingBar and complete onboarding to pick a calendar source
notable: Detects meeting links and supports 50+ services including Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, and Discord
Works with macOS Calendar and Google Calendar
Global keyboard shortcut to join the nearest meeting
caveats: Some features are offered through paid or optional support channels (Patreon, in-app purchases, Buy Me a Coffee)
